## Silo August 2026 Release  [Print](https://support.authentic8.com/support/solutions/articles/16000239793-silo-august-2026-release\# "Print this Article")

Modified on: Fri, Aug 21, 2026 at 6:46 AM

* * *

**Release Date:** August 20, 2026

**Major Features**

**New: Silo Nexus AI v2**

A major update to Silo Nexus AI, adding investigation roles, personal prompt management, additional formats, and a redesigned interface.

- Investigation Roles
  - Choose an investigation role (Financial Crime, OSINT, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Trust & Safety, Law Enforcement, or General Analysis) that tailors how Nexus AI approaches your work.
  - Switch roles mid-conversation. The chat shows a clear marker whenever the role changes.
  - Nexus remembers your last-used role per Workspace, and you can set a default role in Settings.
  - A short onboarding overlay walks new users through picking a role on first use.
- Prompts
  - Create, edit, and delete your own personal prompts alongside the admin and role prompts already available.
- Send content to Nexus AI
  - A new Silo Nexus AI browser extension in Silo Workspace puts a toolbar button and right-click options on every page. Send an image or selected text straight into a current or new analysis.
  - Silo Drive now offers “Send to current Nexus AI analysis” and “Send to new Nexus AI analysis” on right-click, so files go into an investigation without a download-and-upload round trip.
- Document and image analysis
  - Send documents for analysis directly in a conversation.
  - Paste images into the chat input from your local clipboard or from inside the Silo browser, with a preview you can review or remove before sending.
- Redesigned interface
  - Refreshed visual style across the Nexus window, the new chat page, and the browser extension popup.
  - Search within a conversation with Ctrl+F (Cmd+F on Mac), including live highlighting, next/previous navigation, and a match count.
  - Keyboard shortcut tooltips on the search, screen capture, and new chat controls.
  - Clearer messaging when you reach your daily prompt limit, including when it resets and how to get more.

**Improvements**

- Admin Console
  - Added a search box to the Policies tab so administrators can find a policy without scrolling through every section.
  - Added search to the organization tree selector, making it faster to locate a specific org in large hierarchies.
- Other
  - Various under-the-hood platform, reliability, and performance updates.

**Bug Fixes**

- Fixed an issue that prevented saving .HAR files to Silo Drive or local disk, which resulted in 0-byte files.
- Fixed an issue where URL logs were missing the domain attribute for some uploads.

For any additional questions, please contact [Authentic8 Support](https://support.authentic8.com/support/tickets/new).
